correctness.rationale: For every kappa>1, L>0 and independent centered additive noise with variance sigma², the supplied cubic AR(3) follows from delayed extrapolation y_{k-1}; matching coefficients with DREAM equation (81) supplies Schur stability, not assumed stochastic stationarity. Independently eliminated the four Yule–Walker equations and checked R=(1-b-c²-ac)/[(1+a-b+c)(1-a-b-c)(1+b-c²+ac)] by symbolic algebra and eight separate discrete Lyapunov solutions. The q→0 slow/fast expansions yield Rslow~2/q³ and Rfast~16/(7q), hence sigma² kappa^(3/2)/(8L²) and sigma²sqrt(kappa)/(7L²). The delayed-GD characteristic quadratic minimizes worst-case radius at h*=kappa²/[L(kappa+1)²]; its separate AR(2) variance tends to 5sigma²kappa/(6L²), so (3/20)sqrt(kappa) is the ratio. The unbounded assertion is analytic; eight finite Lyapunov cases are corroborative only.
